options.description: Asks with plain lines in and lines out rather than a region that redraws, for a screen reader: the question is written once, what is typed is echoed where it is typed, and nothing already written is ever moved or erased.
options.name: accessible

options.description: Draw with ASCII only. Defaults to what `unicodeSupported()` says.
options.name: ascii

options.description: Whether Escape leaves the prompt to go back a step. Defaults to `false`, where Escape does nothing, as it always has.
options.name: back

options.description: Pick a directory rather than a file. Defaults to `false`.
options.name: directory

options.description: The environment to read the terminal from. Defaults to `process.env`.
options.name: env

options.description: Which files are offered, by extension, with or without the dot. Directories are always offered. The rule `path()` and `filePicker()` have.
options.name: extensions

options.description: The lines between nodes. Defaults to `plain`.
options.name: guide

options.description: Whether the highlight wraps from one end to the other. Defaults to `true`.
options.name: loop

options.description: The platform to detect for. Defaults to `process.platform`.
options.name: platform

options.description: The directory at the top of the tree. Defaults to the working directory. A `~` is expanded.
options.name: root

options.description: The input router to read keys through. One is built if not given.
options.name: router

options.description: How many rows the tree may take. Defaults to what the terminal has left.
options.name: rows

options.description: Gives the prompt up when this aborts, the way Ctrl-C does.
options.name: signal

options.description: Where keys come from. Defaults to the terminal's input.
options.name: stdin

options.description: Checks the answer. Return a string to reject it with that message, or anything falsy to accept.
options.name: validate
options.type: (value: T) => string | undefined | false | Promise<string | undefined | false>

options.description: An answer to start from: a path, which starts highlighted with every directory between it and `root` opened. Dropped when it is not under `root` or is not there any more.
options.name: value

registryDescription: A tree: nested data printed with ├── and └──, a prompt that opens and closes branches read on demand, and a directory tree
